story.iWant: I want events to spawn at regular intervals
story.soThat: So that I have time-pressured tasks to complete during the evening
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Create EventManager class structure (AC: 2) - [ ] Create `src/core/EventManager.ts` file - [ ] Set up class with TypeScript types - [ ] Define private properties: activeEvents array - [ ] Follow class naming conventions [Source: docs/architecture.md#Naming-Conventions] - [ ] Import event types from `src/types/events.ts` [Source: docs/sprint-artifacts/1-2-core-type-definitions.md] - [ ] Import constants from `src/utils/constants.ts` [Source: docs/sprint-artifacts/1-5-game-constants-and-configuration.md]
- [ ] Task 2: Implement spawnEvent method (AC: 1, 4) - [ ] Check if current active events count < max for level - [ ] If below max, randomly select event type (phone, kettle, cat, candle) - [ ] Map event type to priority (phone: standard, kettle: critical, cat: minor, candle: standard) - [ ] Select random valid location from EVENT_LOCATIONS constant - [ ] Get timer duration based on level using getEventTimerDuration() - [ ] Get points value from EVENT_SCORING[priority] - [ ] Get coziness reward/penalty from EVENT_COZINESS_IMPACT[priority] - [ ] Generate unique event id (timestamp + random string) - [ ] Create GameEvent object with all properties - [ ] Add event to activeEvents array - [ ] Return created event or null if spawn failed
- [ ] Task 3: Implement getActiveEvents method (AC: 2) - [ ] Return copy of activeEvents array (defensive copy) - [ ] Return empty array if no active events
- [ ] Task 4: Implement getMaxSimultaneousEvents method (AC: 2, 3) - [ ] Use getMaxSimultaneousEvents() helper from constants.ts - [ ] Return max events for given level - [ ] Handle edge cases (level 0, level > 5)
- [ ] Task 5: Integrate with game loop (AC: 5) - [ ] Add spawn timer state to game loop or EventManager - [ ] Track elapsed time since last spawn - [ ] When spawn interval reached (EVENT_SPAWN_INTERVAL), call spawnEvent() - [ ] Reset spawn timer after successful spawn - [ ] Handle spawn timer in game loop update cycle - [ ] Ensure spawn timer uses delta time (frame-rate independent)
- [ ] Task 6: Integrate with GameContext (AC: 3, 5) - [ ] Add activeEvents to GameState interface if not present - [ ] Add addEvent(event: GameEvent) function to GameContext - [ ] EventManager.addEvent() should update GameContext state - [ ] Ensure activeEvents array is stored in GameContext - [ ] Verify state updates trigger React re-renders
- [ ] Task 7: Implement event type to priority mapping (AC: 4) - [ ] Create mapping: phone → standard, kettle → critical, cat → minor, candle → standard - [ ] Use mapping in spawnEvent() to assign priority - [ ] Store mapping as constant or helper function - [ ] Reference PRD for event type specifications [Source: docs/prd.md#Event-Types]
- [ ] Task 8: Testing and validation (AC: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) - [ ] Test spawnEvent() spawns event when below max - [ ] Test spawnEvent() returns null when at max - [ ] Test getActiveEvents() returns active events - [ ] Test getMaxSimultaneousEvents() returns correct max for each level - [ ] Test event properties are correctly set (type, priority, location, timer, points, coziness) - [ ] Test spawn timer triggers at correct interval - [ ] Test events are added to GameContext state - [ ] Test spawn timer uses delta time (frame-rate independent) - [ ] Test event spawning stops when game is paused or over - [ ] Verify performance (60 FPS maintained)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **Given** the game is running **When** the event spawn timer reaches the interval (3-4 seconds) **Then** a new event is spawned if: - Current active events count is below maximum for player level - Event is randomly selected from available event types (phone, kettle, cat, candle) - Event is assigned a random valid location in the apartment - Event is assigned priority (minor, standard, critical) based on event type - Event timer is set based on player level (5-10 seconds)
2. **Given** the EventManager class is created **When** I use EventManager **Then** it provides: - `spawnEvent(level: number): GameEvent | null` - spawns event if conditions met - `getActiveEvents(): GameEvent[]` - returns currently active events - `getMaxSimultaneousEvents(level: number): number` - returns max events for level
3. **Given** events are spawning **When** events are created **Then** events are stored in game state (activeEvents array) **And** event spawning respects maximum simultaneous events per level: - Level 1-2: 2 events maximum - Level 3-4: 3 events maximum - Level 5+: 4 events maximum
4. **Given** an event is spawned **When** the event is created **Then** the event has correct properties: - Unique id (generated for each event instance) - Type (phone, kettle, cat, or candle) - Priority (minor, standard, or critical) based on event type mapping - Location (x, y coordinates) from valid apartment locations - Timer (seconds) based on player level - Points value from EVENT_SCORING constant - Coziness reward/penalty from EVENT_COZINESS_IMPACT constant
5. **Given** event spawning is implemented **When** the game loop runs **Then** event spawning is integrated with game loop: - Spawn timer tracks elapsed time since last spawn - Spawn timer resets after successful spawn - EventManager.spawnEvent() called at spawn interval - New events added to GameContext activeEvents array - Game state updates trigger React re-renders

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Events appear every 3-4 seconds. Max simultaneous events: Level 1-2: 2 events, Level 3-4: 3 events, Level 5+: 4 events. Each event has a countdown timer (5-10 seconds depending on difficulty).

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Event types: phone (standard priority, +15 points, +8/-10 coziness), kettle (critical priority, +20 points, +10/-20 coziness), cat (minor priority, +10 points, +5/-5 coziness), candle (standard priority, +15 points, +8/-10 coziness).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: EventManager class in core/EventManager.ts manages event lifecycle. Game loop calls EventManager.spawnEvent() every 3-4 seconds. EventManager checks max simultaneous events, creates event with timer/priority/location, adds to active events array.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Classes use PascalCase (EventManager). Functions use camelCase (spawnEvent, getActiveEvents). EventManager is a class (not React component) for testability.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: EventManager class provides spawnEvent(level), getActiveEvents(), getMaxSimultaneousEvents(level). Events stored in game state (activeEvents array). Event spawning respects maximum simultaneous events per level.

doc.title: Story 1.2: Core Type Definitions
doc.snippet: GameEvent interface with id, type, priority, location, timer, points, cozinessReward, cozinessPenalty. EventType union: 'phone' | 'kettle' | 'cat' | 'candle'. EventPriority union: 'minor' | 'standard' | 'critical'.

doc.title: Story 1.5: Game Constants and Configuration
doc.snippet: EVENT_SPAWN_INTERVAL (3.5 seconds), MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_EVENTS (level-based mapping), getMaxSimultaneousEvents(level), EVENT_TIMER_DURATION (level-based), getEventTimerDuration(level), EVENT_SCORING (priority-based points), EVENT_COZINESS_IMPACT (priority-based rewards/penalties), EVENT_LOCATIONS (apartment locations).

doc.title: Story 2.1: Game State Management and Game Loop
doc.snippet: Game loop runs at 60 FPS using requestAnimationFrame. Delta time calculation ensures frame-independent updates. EventManager spawn timer should integrate with game loop. Spawn timer should use delta time for frame-rate independence.

doc.title: Story 2.2: Apartment Layout and Background
doc.snippet: EVENT_LOCATIONS constant already defined in src/utils/constants.ts. Event locations are percentage-based (0.05 to 0.95 for X, 0.10 to 0.90 for Y) for responsive positioning. EventManager should use EVENT_LOCATIONS for event spawning.

doc.title: Story 2.3: Character Visual and Movement System
doc.snippet: Character component uses independent requestAnimationFrame loop. Game loop updates at 60 FPS. Delta time calculation ensures frame-independent updates. EventManager spawn timer should use similar delta time pattern.
